However, this was a misrepresentation as M/s PIL had only two operational kilns at that time having production capacity of 4 LTPA only.
[Note: - Later on, in RC No. 221 2016 E 0035, the capacity of two kilns was found to be 3 LTPA and not even 4 LTPA].

G.K. Basak, Executive Secretary of Joint Plant Committee (JPC) was requested by the Ministry of Steel to personally visit the factory premises of M/s PIL to assess the production capacity of the plant by making a spot verification.

G.K. Basak visited the factory premises of M/s PIL along with Soumen Chatterjee, Manager (Finance and Accounts) and gave a false report that during inspection, 4 kilns were in operation and production capacity of sponge iron plant of M/s PIL was 7,20,000 LTPA.
MoS accepted this report and informed MoC that the annual installed capacity of sponge iron production of Prakash Industries Limited at their Champa unit was 7.2 lakh tonnes per annum.
G.K. Basak falsely reiterated twice while answering the queries of MoS on 25.08.2009 as well as 09/11.01.2010 that M/s PIL had four operational kilns of 7,20,000 LTPA capacity.

Order framing Charges against other accused persons namely M/s PIL and A.K. Chaturvedi, one of the Directors of M/s PIL were set aside by the Hon'ble Delhi High Court vide Order dt. 05.09.2014 in Crl. M.C. No. 2474/2014.
SLP Crl. No. 2756- 2757/2015 filed by CBI challenging that order is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
